colors.usage: Number keys 0-9 and decimal (.calculator-button default variant)

components.name: Button
components.description: Reusable button atom used for all calculator keys with variant styling via className prop.

components.name: Display
components.description: Shows the current calculator value with dynamic font sizing based on string length.

components.name: Login
components.description: Authentication form organism for signing in with email and password, with inline validation error display.

components.name: Signup
components.description: Authentication form organism for registering a new account with email, password, and confirm-password fields.

components.name: Calculator
components.description: Primary organism after authentication; contains Display, theme toggle, and full button grid with arithmetic state machine.

visual_spec.error_recovery: Any digit press after 'Error' resets to that digit

components.name: Input / TextField
components.description: Inline text input pattern used in auth forms for email, password, and confirm-password fields; not extracted as a standalone reusable component.
components.code_example: setEmail(e.target.value)} placeholder="Enter your email" required />

visual_spec.error_display: via .login-error paragraph, not on input itself
